statement.text:
b) Assume a group G is existentially closed in one of the classes LN+ , LSπ ,
LS+ , LS of, respectively, all locally nilpotent torsion-free groups, all locally soluble
π-groups, all locally soluble torsion-free groups, or all locally soluble groups. Is it true
that G is characteristically simple?
   The existential closedness of G is a local property, thus it seems difficult to obtain
global properties of G from it. See also Archive, 8.14 a.                      O. H. Kegel
